d:
Suspected a gallery wipe and scraped what I could before they wiped all NSFW from their account. I wasn't able to save the rest of the artworks, but this is all I could save before the purge, plus a second handful of images from brief windows that they were reuploaded/visible

Doesn't contain the extreme R-18G stuff, sorry. If any more of their artworks was saved, send me a MoogleMail.

UPDATE: Kakku went nuclear and wiped the SFW art too before restarting from a clean slate with the last three images as of the last archival. I was able to salvage some of the SFW art from previous archrivals, but I didn't expect that to happen when I only primarily focused on scraping NSFW art.
